project.name: ConsentLine
project.tagline: Give a workflow the minimum data it is allowed to use.
project.description: Purpose-bound redaction, keyed pseudonyms, span-level evidence and a fail-closed egress decision for synthetic support text.
project.customer: A support platform sharing ticket excerpts with an external analysis vendor

sample.text: Synthetic ticket: reply to mira@example.test or +91 98765 43210. PAN-like identifier ABCDE1234F was pasted by mistake. Repeated contact: mira@example.test.

result.summary: Allow egress for support_summary; 4 detected entities, 4 minimized.
warnings: Synthetic demonstration: regex detectors cover only email, phone-like and PAN-like strings; names, addresses and other sensitive content may remain.
Consent is supplied test data, not authenticated evidence or a legal compliance determination.
Pseudonyms remain linkable within this purpose and key; protect keys and apply a retention policy.
